New quantitative finding: at 2.1% TP margin on L40S, flat TPE cannot reliably identify the optimal TP within budget=100, while bracket K=1 succeeds deterministically in 3 evals.

discrepancy_analysis: All 4 arms confirmed. h-ablation shows a magnitude deviation: flat TPE on L40S is even worse than predicted (median evals_to_best=101, 4/5 seeds fail vs expected ~26 evals). This discrepancy reveals that TP margin size has a strong non-linear effect on TPE convergence reliability: the 2.1% L40S margin vs 7.6% H100 margin is not just quantitatively smaller but qualitatively changes whether TPE can reliably identify the optimal TP at all. Bracket K=1's hardware-agnostic max-profile Phase 1 is immune to this effect since it directly evaluates all TP candidates at maximum batch capacity.
